corrections: Added pause/resume that preserves sequence, recent ring, overflow/outlier counts, and worst record so paired 30-second extension windows can continue within the one boot-scoped session.
Renamed the per-record cost to traceCaptureBodyCycles and explicitly excluded final self-accounting write/critical-section exit; whole-window A/B is the full observer-effect measurement.
Trace start and resume fail closed if runtime CPU MHz does not match compiled/captured MHz; JSON readback exposes compile, trace-start, and readback frequency.
Frozen 42.03125 ms p99 ceiling is evidence only during this diagnostic; only existing catastrophic 3-consecutive-sample gates abort. Production thresholds are unchanged.

build.runtime_observer_overhead: NOT MEASURED; offline disassembly/static data only.

protocol.reason: Quiet measurement windows disallow polling; the existing catastrophic early-stop requires valid 8-second samples and three consecutive bad samples. No evidence-backed way currently satisfies both without polling during the windows or changing the frozen safety rule.
protocol.p99_failure_rule: p99 >42.03125 ms is recorded and does not stop capture; p99 >75 ms for three consecutive 8-second samples remains catastrophic per frozen policy.
protocol.bounded_extension: 60-second matched windows; if either has fewer than 2,000 frames or trace has fewer than 20 outliers, extend in matched 30-second pairs to a strict maximum 180 seconds per condition. Insufficient evidence at the cap is INCONCLUSIVE.
protocol.required_future_owner_authorization: Fresh exact-artifact admission for one diagnostic install and one exact R4 restoration at transaction end; no diagnostic retry, R8, AUX/router/cloud change, or production claim.
